const.role_prose: introduces a named value binding that may not be re-bound afterwards

let.role_prose: introduces a named value binding that may be re-bound afterwards

of.role_prose: separates the iteration name from the sequence it walks

continue.role_prose: proceeds to the next iteration of the innermost loop

number.role_prose: the numeric type name used by the task; whole-number values are exact

void.role_prose: the result-less designation: the result type of a function that yields nothing

not_lexicalized.K06: expressed as the K05 token followed by the K04 token; this language has no distinct chained-alternative word
not_lexicalized.K12: no aggregate type is needed by the task set
not_lexicalized.K13: no aggregate type is needed by the task set
not_lexicalized.K14: the task needs no import; every facility it uses is globally available
not_lexicalized.K15: this language needs no compilation-unit declaration for a single-file program
not_lexicalized.K18: logical conjunction is punctuation in this language, not a word token (NOT_WORD_TOKEN)
not_lexicalized.K19: logical disjunction is punctuation in this language, not a word token (NOT_WORD_TOKEN)
not_lexicalized.K20: logical negation is punctuation in this language, not a word token (NOT_WORD_TOKEN)
not_lexicalized.K21d: the dynamic-sequence type is written as a punctuation suffix on the element type, not as a word token (NOT_WORD_TOKEN)
not_lexicalized.K22: this language marks no entry point with a word token; top-level statements run in order
not_lexicalized.K23: this language needs no visibility or linkage marker for a single-file program
not_lexicalized.K24: this language has no mutability qualifier distinct from the K03 binding word
not_lexicalized.K25: the type annotation is introduced by punctuation, not by a word token (NOT_WORD_TOKEN)
not_lexicalized.K26: no conversion word token is needed; conversion is a named facility, which I1 does not transform
not_lexicalized.K27: the output facility of this language declares no error propagation

not_transformed_in_I1.reason: V-roles keep their real spellings in I1 (methodology 10, 7.1)
